# Vendored Firebase SDK

Unmodified Firebase JS SDK 12.4.0 compat builds, served from Hosting so the app needs no npm or build step. Hosting does not publish this file. Replace a file only with the same release's build from the source URL, then update its SHA-256 here.

| File | Version | Source | SHA-256 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `firebase-app-compat.js` | 12.4.0 | https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/12.4.0/firebase-app-compat.js | `1942fbb78a44a1454ad3eed44b41286008a7a6ef3196ff8235e40ef3b42f23d2` |
| `firebase-auth-compat.js` | 12.4.0 | https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/12.4.0/firebase-auth-compat.js | `7b9e16a5d41ba11d6c8b54daafab9072bf45a81f9972887a2fcb808ea9462edd` |
| `firebase-app-check-compat.js` | 12.4.0 | https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/12.4.0/firebase-app-check-compat.js | `d308cedfed056800dfa63de7d8a304e644d4e6fd3378e908e751ae9dc782b1d7` |

`app.js` loads the App Check build only when `APP_CHECK_SITE_KEY` is set; see [App Check](../../docs/app-check.md).
